VRI abbreviates introductory and concluding formulas with …pe…; ATI gives them at length. The same training formula is explicit in VRI SN 17.1. The bundled Pāli abbreviations are preserved; this is not line-by-line alignment or a reconstruction of missing Pāli. Source “See also” references are editorial.

Pasenadi’s judgment complaint, the Buddha’s agreement and the concluding fish-in-a-trap verse establish identity. VRI abbreviates the speech-to-verse transition with …pe…; ATI spells it out and abbreviates a repeated wealth description.
